arguments.sql:
WITH scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS other_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stack_rows
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
step_results AS (
    SELECT m.name, m.version, m.step, m.L1_model,
           CASE WHEN s.stack_score > s.other_score THEN 'strong'
                WHEN s.stack_score = s.other_score THEN 'soft' END AS status
    FROM scores AS s
    JOIN main.model AS m USING (name, version, step)
    WHERE s.stack_score >= s.other_score
),
stored_only AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM main.stack_ok
    EXCEPT SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM step_results
),
computed_only AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM step_results
    EXCEPT SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM main.stack_ok
)
SELECT 'step results' AS check_name, L1_model, status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM step_results GROUP BY L1_model, status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model-status associations', L1_model, status, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status FROM step_results)
GROUP BY L1_model, status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stored only', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM stored_only
UNION ALL
SELECT 'computed only', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM computed_only
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multiple Stack rows per step', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM scores WHERE stack_rows > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multiple L1 values per model', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version FROM main.model GROUP BY name, version HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT L1_model) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate model step keys', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version, step FROM main.model GROUP BY name, version, step HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model with both statuses', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version FROM step_results GROUP BY name, version HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT status) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'L1 mismatch against solution_ext', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM step_results AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM main.solution_ext AS e
    WHERE e.name = r.name AND e.version = r.version AND e.L1_model = r.L1_model
)

arguments.sql:
WITH step_scores AS (
    SELECT name,
           version,
           step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS best_non_stack_score
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.name,
           m.version,
           m.L1_model,
           CASE
               WHEN s.stack_score > s.best_non_stack_score THEN 'strong'
               WHEN s.stack_score = s.best_non_stack_score THEN 'soft'
           END AS status
    FROM step_scores AS s
    JOIN main.model AS m
      ON m.name = s.name AND m.version = s.version AND m.step = s.step
    WHERE s.stack_score >= s.best_non_stack_score
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT status,
           L1_model,
           occurrence_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) AS status_rank
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked
WHERE status_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
